purpose: Published measurements the PDAC tissue model can be tested against.
why_ratios_and_not_absolute_values: Published PANC-1 monolayer gemcitabine IC50 values span 58 nM to 31.41 uM,
three orders of magnitude, because studies differ in assay duration, readout,
passage number and serum. Absolute potencies therefore cannot be pooled across
papers and cannot serve as calibration targets. This is the same assay
heterogeneity that made the ChEMBL dataset expansion fail; see
A ratio measured within one study has those confounders cancel, so paired
within-study ratios are the only quantities recorded here.
verification_policy: Every record carries a verification field.
unverified_snippet  the value was transcribed from a search engine result
summarising the paper, NOT read in the paper itself. It
may be misattributed, rounded, or taken out of context.
verified_primary    someone opened the cited source, confirmed the number,
the cell line, the assay and the comparison, and recorded
their initials and the date in verified_by.
scripts/calibrate_tissue_model.py refuses to report a calibration from
unverified records. It will compute and display the comparison so the harness
can be exercised, and it will state that the result is not a calibration.
Promoting a record to verified_primary is a contribution that needs no code.

observations.description: Murine Panc02 gemcitabine IC50, spheroid against monolayer, same study.
model_mapping_note: The tissue model is a vascularised 2D tumour slice, not a spheroid, so
there is no exact analogue of a monolayer arm. The closest comparison is
a dense low-perfusion configuration against a sparse well-perfused one.
The mapping is approximate and the harness says so.
observations.source_note: Reversible chemoresistance of pancreatic cancer grown as spheroids

observations.description: PANC-1 spheroid-derived cells against parental, three drugs, same study.
model_mapping_note: These are cells selected by spheroid culture and then re-assayed, which
is a heritable phenotype change rather than a geometry or transport
effect. The tissue model has no mechanism for culture-induced selection,
so it cannot represent this observation at all. Recorded because a
harness that silently omits what the model cannot express overstates its
observations.source_note: Transcriptome profiling of Panc-1 spheroid cells

observations.description: PANC-1 gemcitabine IC50 with cancer-associated fibroblasts at 9:1 against PANC-1 alone, same study.
model_mapping_note: The model carries CAFs as an explicit cell type that deposits ECM and
attenuates drug diffusivity, so a with-and-without run is a direct
analogue. This is the primary calibration target available.
observations.source_note: Inclusion of cancer-associated fibroblasts in drug screening assays

observations.description: Doxorubicin reaches the core of 480 um PANC-1 spheroids within 12 h at all concentrations tested.
model_mapping_note: A falsifiable upper bound on beta_ECM, the ECM attenuation coefficient in
D_eff = D_0 / (1 + beta * ECM). If the model predicts a steep unresolved
gradient over 240 um of dense tissue in 12 hours, the barrier is stronger
than this measurement allows. Doxorubicin is not gemcitabine, but both
are small molecules and the constraint is on transport, not potency.
observations.source_note: Concave microwells applied to pancreatic tumour spheroids

what_the_model_assumes: The PDAC module's headline mechanism is that desmoplastic ECM physically
attenuates drug diffusion, D_eff = D_0 / (1 + beta * ECM), producing a
transport barrier that limits exposure in the tumour core.

evidence_for.claim: Gemcitabine and doxorubicin do not penetrate far into KPC mouse tumours; poor response attributed to poor vascularisation and stroma-driven interstitial pressure.

evidence_against.claim: In two orthotopic murine models gemcitabine was distributed nearly homogeneously, reaching both hypoxic and normoxic regions, and the authors concluded tissue penetration did not appear to limit its efficacy.

consequence: The literature is genuinely contested on whether transport is what limits
gemcitabine in PDAC. The model rests on the first position. A calibration
that cannot return the answer 'the barrier is the wrong mechanism' is not a
calibration, so the harness reports the penetration constraint separately
and does not treat the barrier as given.
